content_sections.heading: About DME Tripura Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Directorate of Medical Education, Government of Tripura, manages medical, dental, and allied health educational institutions across the state. This recruitment process aims to engage qualified dental faculty members on a contractual basis for Agartala Government Dental College & I.G.M Hospital, Agartala under the Health & Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Tripura.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notification announces 5 vacancies across dental specialties: In case of non availability of ST /SC candidate, suitable candidate will be selected from UR candidate. content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The upper age limits on the date of application are: Professor: Age should not be more than 55 (fifty-five) years on the date of application. Associate Professor: Age should not be more than 50 (fifty) years on the date of application. Candidates must be Indian Nationals of state domicile for 02 (two) nos. of post of Professor and 03(three) nos. of post of Associate Professor. However, the pre requisite of state domicile status shall be relaxed in case no suitable candidate of state domicile is available for the said post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contractual basis for a period of 11 (eleven) months which will be renewed further, subject to satisfactory performance. The authority reserves the right for placement of all the above-mentioned faculties employed on contractual basis to any discipline at any time as per the need of the institutions. Leave rules will be governed as per TDES rules. TA & DA is not admissible for appearing in the interview.

rows.consolidated_pay: Consolidated pay of Rs 1,92,500/- per months

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done as per 50% from Academic performance index (API) as calculated by the department + 50% from Interview / personality test (Total-100 marks). The date of interview will be notified later on.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DME Tripura Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed format may be collected from the O/O the Agartala Govt. Dental College, IGM Hospital, Agartala on any working days from 11.00 AM to 4.00 P.M. or the same can be downloaded from the official web sites. Submit application in prescribed format on or before 10th November, 2026 up to 5 p.m. positively. The application should be addressed to the Principal, Agartala Government Dental College & I.G.M Hospital, I.G.M Hospital Complex, Agartala, West Tripura, Pin-799001. Enclose self-attested copies of caste certificate (ST/SC) age proof certificate, PRTC (in case of state domicile BDS & MDS degree certificate, Registration Certificate of Dental Council, other qualification certificate, Experience Certificate (if any) with his/her application & the original certificate must be produced at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates will have to enclose self-attested copies of certificates (two sets) and produce original certificates at the time of selection: Mark sheet of Madhyamik Mark sheet of HS(+2) AADHAR CARD BDS mark sheet, attempt certificate, BDS Degree INTERNSHIP COMPLETION CERTIFICATE MDS mark sheet and attempt certificate, MDS Degree Work Experience & other qualifications (if any) Gold medal in BDS, MDS Publication in Indexed Journal as per DCI regulation, (Pubmed/Scopus/Web of Science)/(Original Research/Review/Case Report) *(1st /2nd / Corresponding author) Form 16 (last Three years) Updated Dental Registration Certificate Caste Certificate (if any) Age Proof Certificate & Nationality Proof Certificate Permanent Resident Certificate Two copies of all documents and photograph CV of the Candidate Hand written and self-attested undertaking by the candidate stating as under: "I hereby declare that all the information given / uploaded by me in the application are factually correct and true to the best of my knowledge and belief. I undertake that in the event of any information being found false or incorrect at any stage, my candidature is liable to be cancelled and I will have no claim on my selection to the post of Associate Professor/ Professor by the competent authority."

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DME Tripura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies, including 2 posts of Professor and 3 posts of Associate Professor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is on or before 10th November, 2026 up to 5 p.m. positively.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: A BDS Degree of an Indian University or an equivalent qualification with Post Graduate qualification/ Diplomate Graduate of National Board in the concerned subject and as amended by DCI from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the teaching experience required for Professor and Associate Professor?
faq.answer: Professor requires 05 (five) years teaching experiences as Reader or Associate Professor from recognized dental college. Associate Professor requires 04 (four) years teaching experiences as Assistant Professor/ Lecturer from recognized Dental College.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DME Tripura Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age should not be more than 55 (fifty-five) years for Professor and not more than 50 (fifty) years for Associate Professor on the date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly consolidated salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay of Rs 1,92,500/- per months for Professor and Rs 1,37,500/- per month for Associate Professor.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for DME Tripura Dental College posts?
faq.answer: Selection will be done as per 50% from Academic performance index (API) as calculated by the department + 50% from Interview / personality test (Total-100 marks).

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual appointment?
faq.answer: Engagement is on contractual basis for a period of 11 (eleven) months which will be renewed further, subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Tripura apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications are invited from Indian National of state domicile, but the pre requisite of state domicile status shall be relaxed in case no suitable candidate of state domicile is available for the said post.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for ST, SC, PH/PwD. & Govt. in services candidates.
